parsed.reason: The watch promise is backed (watch=true) and correctly in the first person, and the message asks no question and makes no unearned negative claim about a page. But the pick list is empty for a subject the fixture says is always running somewhere: EarlyON-style free drop-ins. The message is also the vague kind of empty result the rubric penalises. It never says what was searched or which sources were checked ('the sources I checked'). It hedges ('that doesn't mean none exists') instead of naming anything, so the parent is left with only a promise to come back.
